Halle Berry Accused of Child Abuse by Ex-Husband Olivier Martinez

Halle Berry's ex-husband, Olivier Martinez, has accused the actress of physically abusing their 12-year-old son, Maceo. Martinez claims Berry "choked" the child. Berry's lawyer has denied the allegations, calling Martinez's court filing "entirely meritless and deliberately misleading."
